# AI Art Engine (AIArtEngine)

> Open-source (GPL-3.0), local-first, agent-native multimodal AI production studio & game/film asset engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux (v9.0.1). Unlike chat-only or flat-image AIGC tools, AI Art Engine combines a typed multimodal DAG node graph, 10+ full-screen Dive workbenches, an embedded in-process Pi Agent runtime (with an on-demand lazy MCP toolset engine), and a 102-tool local MCP server (`127.0.0.1:43110` + `npx -y ai-art-engine-mcp`) to ship editable engineering deliverables: layered `.psd` files with native `TySh` editable text layers, Unity UGUI/UXML & Godot 4 `.tscn` UI code, Spine 2D (`skeleton.json` + `.atlas`) bone rigs, Machinations game economy & systems balance simulations (with C#/GDScript export), 5-stage 21-genre AI Comic Drama (漫剧) episodes, JianyingPro/CapCut multi-track NLE drafts, `.glb` 3D assets, and headless-Chromium smoke-tested playable HTML5 games.

- Official Website (ZH): https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/
- Official Website (EN): https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/index.en.html
- Live Online Machinations v2 Playground: https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/playground/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Justin-sky/ai-art-engine
- Gitee Mirror: https://gitee.com/beijing_blue_whale_era_zhangjian/ai-art-engine
- Releases (Windows `.exe`, macOS `.dmg`, Linux `.AppImage`): https://github.com/Justin-sky/ai-art-engine/releases
- Pi Agent 9.0 Architecture Reference: https://github.com/Justin-sky/ai-art-engine/blob/main/docs/PI_AGENT.md
- Full LLM Technical Reference: https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/llms-full.txt

## Flagship Capabilities & Deliverables

- **Game UI Layer Split, PSD `TySh` & Engine Code Export (`image.layerSplit`, `ui.atlasCompose`, `ui.componentLib`)**: Recognizes 16 standard UI control classes, runs cross-platform offline/online OCR to extract exact text fill & stroke colors, inpaints clean 9-slice plates, previews layers in an interactive 3D exploded view, composes UI pages from uploaded texture atlases, and exports layered `.psd` (with native Photoshop `TySh` editable text layers), Unity UGUI / UI Toolkit `.uxml`, Godot 4 `.tscn`, and responsive HTML5.
- **Machinations v2 Game Economy & Systems Studio (`game.economy`)**: 100% Machinations-aligned game mechanics & economy simulator with 59 verified building blocks, lossless Simple Macro ↔ Pro Blueprint toggle, zero-code Playable Card & HUD Prototype, 120fps Bezier slope control point (`◆`) & direct curve-drag inverse Goal-Seek formula solver (`k * pow(STEP, p)`), Monte Carlo P10/P50/P90 confidence bands, 2D parameter sensitivity heatmap, Quick-Fix balance diagnostics, and PNG/SVG/CSV/Unity C#/Godot GDScript export.
- **AI Comic Drama (AI 漫剧 / Short Drama) 5-Stage Workbench (`film.workbench`)**: Built-in 21 vertical short-drama genre blueprints (`P01`–`P21`), covering Stage 1 Beat Breakdown (`A + B` dual rhythm), Stage 2 11-point Director Continuity & ≥67% Dialogue Audit, Stage 3 Character `#variant` / Scene / Prop / `STYLE01` Anchors + Cross-Episode TTS Voice Binding, Stage 4 `@1`–`@4` Locked Batch Video Shoot with Vision QC auto-reshoots & fingerprint caching, and Stage 5 Cover/Title Release Pack + Full Episode `.mp4`.
- **2-Node Forensic Video Breakdown & Remake (`semantic.analyze` → `semantic.rebuild`, `rea-video`)**: Deconstructs any reference video across 4 axes (WhisperX word-level ASR, PySceneDetect cuts, Librosa BPM/beats, Demucs stems + 3-frame VLM camera forensics), generates clean-plate background anchors with subtitle removal, and remakes every shot with lip-sync, kinetic `.ass` subtitles, and side-by-side `compare.mp4`.
- **CapCut-Grade NLE Timeline (`output.timeline`)**: Multi-track video/audio/subtitle editor with a 6-tab creative suite (120+ GPU/FFmpeg effects, transitions, LUTs, color wheels, curves, presets), DOTween dual-layer keyframe animations, TD-PSOLA pitch/singing synthesis, `.mp4` master rendering, and one-click JianyingPro / CapCut editable multi-track draft export.
- **2D Bone Rigging & Spine 2D Export (`stage.2d`) + Wavelet Portrait Studio (`image.portrait`)**: Auto part segmentation, occluded-edge dilation inpainting, AI bone alignment (Alpha morphology + YOLOv8-Pose), IK constraints, keyframe baking to Spine 2D (`skeleton.json` + `.atlas` + `.png`), plus 4-band à-trous wavelet frequency-separation skin retouching and 7 camera/film color sciences.
- **3D Director Stage (`director.stage`), World Labs 3DGS & Blender MCP**: 56-bone humanoid posing, 24 procedural motion clips, 38 pose presets, offscreen `.webm` camera trajectory white-box previz (`@2`), walkable World Labs Marble 3D Gaussian Splatting worlds, and a 9-tool Blender MCP bridge (`execute_blender_code` → viewport screenshot → `.glb` asset import).
- **In-Process Pi Agent 9.0 Runtime, On-Demand Lazy MCP Engine & 102-Tool MCP Server**: Embedded in-process Pi Agent (`src/main/agent/`, built on `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core` & `@earendil-works/pi-ai`) featuring the `load_toolset` on-demand lazy MCP engine (~24 core tools initially + dynamic loading of 6 Studio/Blender domain toolsets and external MCP `ext:<serverId>` with zero-turn intent pre-warming and `MAX_ACTIVE_TOOLS = 96 < 128` LRU eviction — eliminating the 128-tool API limit while preserving prompt prefix caches), dual-layer `Craft / Plan / Ask` mode gating, live mid-turn `🛡️ Restricted Mode` (`workspace-write`) / `🔓 Full Access` (`danger-full-access`) sandbox switching, lock-free atomic JSON sessions (`<userData>/dsh-harness/pi-sessions/<sessionId>.json` with 6-session parallel runs, instant cross-provider model switching, rewind/fork, and `.zip` export), 24-hour (`00:00–23:59`) scheduled automations, Zero-Key instant live demo, and a `127.0.0.1:43110` Streamable HTTP MCP server (`93` core tools on `/mcp` + `9` Blender tools on `/mcp/blender`) + zero-dependency `npx -y ai-art-engine-mcp` stdio bridge for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf.
- **Workflow-in-PNG (`aiae:graph`) & Local ONNX Vision**: Every exported PNG embeds its reproducible node graph (`aiae:graph` chunk — drag the PNG back onto the canvas to restore the pipeline). Ships offline ONNX Runtime inference (YOLOv8 detect/seg/pose, 468-pt FaceMesh, SAM 2.1, Rembg) and native OS offline OCR on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

- [MCP Server & External Agent Guide (EN)](https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/guide-mcp.en.html): Connecting Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to all 102 MCP tools (`/mcp` + `/mcp/blender`).
- [Playable HTML5 Game Guide (EN)](https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/guide-gameplay.en.html): Building headless-Chromium verified playable HTML5 games and game systems.
- [ComfyUI Integration Guide (EN)](https://justin-sky.github.io/ai-art-engine/guide-comfyui.en.html): Connecting local/remote ComfyUI workflows and `comfy-api-proxy`.
